Recommended fix (host): keep the latest finger span in the pinch state (update it on every two-finger touchmove). In the ResizeObserver callback, only when the zoom actually changed (zoom.current !== was) and a pinch is held, rebase the pinch to the corrected zoom and the latest span: pinch = { distance: latestSpan, zoom: zoom.current }. When the zoom did not change, leave the pinch untouched (scrollbar-triggered callbacks must not affect gestures). This makes the next move scale from what is on screen, whatever control set it. Accepted side effect: if the fingers were spread past the maximum when a resize clamps, the pinch-in dead zone is dropped (the page shrinks at once) - mention it in the report.
